fact: The National Cybersecurity Policy 2022-2026 (revised September 2022) says the use of standards as best practice is non-existent in some government sectors, directs GM-CSIRT to develop standards with the Gambia Standards Bureau benchmarked on ISO/IEC 27001/27002, and makes private institutions subject to an annual audit against ISO 27001/27002; it sets no such requirement on public bodies.
title: The National Cybersecurity Policy of The Gambia 2022-2026 (Revised Version)
